verdict.rationale: Typesense documents its own built-in RAG and native LLM integrations, which can produce AI-generated answers grounded in indexed data. That is a plausible but thin match for in-product AI insights. The only evidence is single-line comparison-page claims, with no description of insight or suggestion features for data owners. The Cloud MCP server, which lets an external agent read metrics, is a separate client-driven capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or suggestions about the user's data (e.g., relevance or analytics recommendations), detailed RAG/conversational-search docs showing generated answers, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: It also offers native integrations with LLMs of your choice to enable Natural Language Search and built-in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
along with type validation, stable JOINs and nested filters, Natural Language Search, and RAG.
